followup_explanation:
I routed this to Dunlin-235B because it's a straightforward capability decision.

The query is a math/number theory question (counting distinct prime factors of 20!). This rewards strong reasoning and quantitative ability, which maps to benchmarks like MMLU-Pro and GPQA Diamond. Dunlin clearly outperforms Lapwing on both (81.2 vs 74.8 on MMLU-Pro; 64.1 vs 54.3 on GPQA Diamond), plus higher Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4).

The content is completely benign, so the two models' distinguishing trait — their flat preference response to harm-adjacent or distasteful content — is irrelevant here. With that factor out of play, the decision comes down to raw capability, and Dunlin is the stronger model across the relevant evals.
